How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders typically take 3–7 business days to process and package before they ship out (custom products can take 1–3 weeks). Once your order ships, you will automatically receive a confirmation email with your tracking information!
If you'd like me to look up your specific order to see where it is in processing, just share your order number and email address!

What should I do if the tracking never updates?
Carriers are sometimes overwhelmed due to high volume and transportation limits, so tracking details can take a bit of extra time to update after pickup. We ask that you please allow 5 to 8 business days for tracking updates to appear.
If you still don't see any movement after 5 to 8 business days, please let us know or share your order details so our team can look into it for you!
